name: 8oz Coffee
note: Independently confirmed a genuine multi-city Saudi specialty-coffee chain (Riyadh, Dhahran, Dammam, Al Khobar, Buraydah), a homegrown Eastern-region brand; F&B is the highest-repeat approved category and the physical chain supplies Gate 5a substantiality even though the online store is small. Site returns 403 (alive-but-blocked, not dead).

name: Al Hasawi Industrial Group
note: Operator Alhasawi Group is Kuwait-HQ'd (Kuwait City, 100+ GCC stores) and acekuwait.com is a live KWD consumer store with broad general-merchandise/home breadth (kitchenware, decor, cleaning, garden, camping, storage). Note a genuine category tension: it also carries heavy hardware/DIY/building lines, but the consumer general-merchandise model and breadth place it in the approved home/general-merchandise bucket rather than B2B construction supply.

name: aDawliah Electronics
note: The on-file Kuwait domain is confirmed hijacked gambling spam, and the 'live e-commerce' the prior note credited (adawliahshop.com) is actually the Saudi sister entity's store (Riyadh address/011 phone), so the qualifying evidence was cross-contaminated. The Kuwait entity is real with genuine mall showrooms, but its own live consumer digital channel (Gate 4) is unconfirmed.

name: Alaysh International Group
note: The live store at alaysh.com is a genuine Kuwait consumer operation (KWD, working cart, hundreds of SKUs across supermarket, camping/outdoor, fresh, household) -- all approved categories. The relocated-domain check that the prior exclusion missed is confirmed.

name: Aleef
note: Confirmed a real Saudi pet retailer (est. 2015, first dedicated online pet store in KSA) with 5+ Riyadh branches, a live store, a Google Play app, and a broad catalog (food, toys, beds, cages, litter, grooming); pet supplies are explicitly approved and pet food/litter are high-repeat.

name: Mohammed Alkhuraiji Industrial Company
note: A Saudi (Riyadh) SFDA-licensed perfume/cosmetics manufacturer that also runs a genuine live D2C Salla store (SAR cart, 8+ beauty categories, BOGO, reviews, free-shipping threshold); beauty/perfume is approved and high-repeat, so it qualifies on the retail arm's own merits. Exact SKU count could not be independently pinned to the prior note's 370, but a multi-category beauty D2C store clears the substantiality floor in practice.

name: ALMAKTABA
note: Confirmed a real 1958-founded 14-branch Saudi stationery/general-merchandise retailer, but the live transactional digital channel does not hold up: the on-file domain fails DNS entirely, the Zid store returns only 403, the Play app's installs are unconfirmed, and the live almaktaba.co is a separate USD-priced B2B office-supply company. Genuine Gate 4 ambiguity, which the prior note itself flagged.

name: مفارش العييري
note: Live Saudi Salla store plus an app, but independent checks describe it as 'primarily bedding/mattresses/sleep supplies' (plus towels, home decor, air fresheners), a Gate 3 low-repeat concern rather than the broad 8-category assortment the prior note asserted. The 50k+ app-install figure that would trigger the Gate 5b rescue could not be independently confirmed via a direct app-store check.

name: IKEA Alsulaiman
note: Operating entity Ghassan Ahmed Al Sulaiman Furniture Trading Co. is genuinely Saudi-HQ'd (Jeddah), IKEA's first global franchise since 1983, with 3 large in-Kingdom stores and full live e-commerce (ikea.com/sa); broad home furnishings is an approved category and this matches the locally-HQ'd-franchise-operator pass pattern.

name: السلطان | AlSultan
note: Live Saudi Salla store (SAR) with an independently-confirmed 8-category assortment extending well beyond bed linens (hotel linens, robes, fragrances, prayer rugs, bathroom accessories, ~50-100+ SKUs); broad, seasonally-refreshed/gifted home textiles clear Gate 3.

name: Green Wing Co. W.L.L
note: Anotah is a Kuwait-HQ'd fashion chain (Green Wing Group, founded Kuwait 1998) with 41+ regional stores and a broad fashion catalog (womenswear, kids/teens, bags, accessories); e-commerce reality is corroborated by the corporate profile and multiple third-party marketplaces, and the earlier domain-compromise state has resolved.

name: Arriyadh Roaster محمصة الرياض
note: Live Saudi Salla DTC store with a multi-line consumer catalog (coffee, Saudi coffee, matcha, capsules, equipment, bundles); coffee is high-repeat approved F&B and the coexisting wholesale/roasting arm is non-disqualifying under the corrected Gate 2 hybrid clause.

name: Bed Quarter Company
note: Independently confirmed a substantial Saudi-HQ'd home retailer (Maz Holding) with 26 showrooms across Saudi Arabia and a broad assortment (mattresses, bedroom furniture, bath/table linen, bedding accessories, Ogawa wellness) -- a multi-line home operation, not narrow mattress-only, so it clears Gate 3 on scale and breadth.

name: Dkhoon Emirates
note: Despite the 'Emirates' brand name (heritage positioning), the operating entity is confirmed Saudi-HQ'd in Riyadh across multiple corporate sources (SignalHire 'Riyadh...SA' with an explicit 'not the UAE' note, Dealroom, LinkedIn) plus a Saudi VAT/CR and SAR checkout; perfume/oud is an approved high-repeat category and the company is substantial (100-200 employees, wide range).
